Summary: Optimize animation performance and battery usage
Creator: Ömer YILMAZ
Description:
h2. Context

Multiple simultaneous animations on egg, infinite animations drain battery, confetti particles not cleaned up immediately.

h2. Requirements

* Implement animation budgeting (max concurrent animations)
* Pause animations when app backgrounded
* Clean up particles immediately after fade
* Use native driver for all animations
* Profile and optimize heavy animations

h2. Technical Details

* Add AppState listener to pause animations
* Audit all Reanimated animations for useNativeDriver
* Implement animation manager/coordinator
* Profile with Flipper or React DevTools

h2. Acceptance Criteria

* [ ] Consistent 60fps during animations
* [ ] Battery usage reduced when idle/backgrounded
* [ ] No memory leaks from animations
* [ ] All animations use native driver where possible

h2. Labels

ui-ux, performance, phase-5

Summary: Redesign session controls with improved button hierarchy
Creator: Ömer YILMAZ
Description:
h2. Context

Controls at bottom could be more prominent, give up button placement could lead to accidental taps, pause count indicator is subtle.

h2. Requirements

* Create floating action bar with clear button hierarchy
* Add safe distance between destructive (give up) and constructive actions
* Make pause count indicator more prominent with visual badges
* Add micro-animations on button state changes
* Consider swipe gestures for common actions

h2. Technical Details

* Create SessionControls component
* Update PixelButton for new variants if needed
* Implement swipe gesture with react-native-gesture-handler

h2. Acceptance Criteria

* [ ] Primary action (start/pause/resume) is most prominent
* [ ] Destructive actions require deliberate interaction (separated by > 24px)
* [ ] Pause count clearly visible at all times
* [ ] Button state changes have micro-animations

h2. Labels

ui-ux, home-screen, phase-2

Summary: Audit and fix spacing consistency across all components
Creator: Ömer YILMAZ
Description:
h2. Context

Some components have inconsistent padding, screen margins vary, and touch targets are occasionally below 44px minimum.

h2. Requirements

* Audit all components for spacing consistency

* Ensure all interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets

* Review all components in src/components/
* Update theme.ts spacing scale if needed
* Add hitSlop to buttons/touchables where needed

* [ ] All touch targets >= 44x44px
* [ ] Consistent 8px grid alignment
* [ ] Screen padding standardized across all views
* [ ] No spacing inconsistencies visible
